regime.label: Stress easing, relief rally
regime.summary: Mon: S&P 500 +5.1% after 7 losing days, Nasdaq +7%, Nvidia +34% on Huang's return. VIX about 27, down from about 36 Fri. A Dec 9 Fed hike is still priced; PCE inflation Wed 17:30 Dubai is the next test. US closed Thu, early close Fri.

brief: US stocks jump about 5% after Nvidia brought back Huang: Nvidia is up about 34% (about $169) and VIX fell to about 27, still above 25. Hold Nvidia, keep the $78.50 SPYM limit, no lab trade today; CrowdStrike's 9-10% drop on its Zscaler deal is WATCH, not a buy.

todo.focus: Big relief rally, VIX still about 27. Hold Nvidia, no lab trade, keep the $78.50 SPYM limit.

items.text: Open the Radar: no lab trade or rocket while VIX is above 25 (about 27 at 11:00 ET)
SPYM is WAIT: place a limit BUY 6 at $78.50 today, good till Wed Dec 9
Nvidia +34% today on Huang's return. HOLD: do not add, do not sell the jump
Lab rules: place the hard stop order right after buying
Check open lab trades: none open once the Cerebras sale is recorded

cards.name: EVENT: Nvidia brings back Huang as CEO
cards.trigger: HOLD. Do not chase the jump. Review only if the SEC files charges, Nvidia restates or cuts its growth guide. No lab trade while VIX is above 25.
cards.story: A relief rally inside a correction: Nvidia is still about 20% below a month ago and the probe is open. A Dec 9 Fed hike is still priced.

cards.name: S&P 500 ETF (SPYM)
cards.trigger: WAIT. Place a limit BUY 6 SPYM at $78.50, good till Wed Dec 9. If it has not filled after the Fed decision, the Radar sets a new limit on Dec 10.
cards.story: The 500 biggest US companies for 0.02% a year. Bought only lower while the correction runs.

cards.name: Richemont (Cartier) · Zurich
cards.trigger: WAIT. No new order today. After the Fri Nov 27 close: BUY 2 at CHF 168 or that close, whichever is lower, only if Hermes made no new low and CFR holds CHF 160.
cards.story: Net profit +39% while luxury peers grow 1-2%. Q2 slowed to +13%; analyst average target about CHF 210.

cards.name: Eaton
cards.trigger: WAIT. Cancel the $335 limit if it did not fill. ETN broke $311.92 Fri, so the Dec 4 review is off. Reconsider only after 2 closes in a row above $330.
cards.story: Sales +28% (organic +19%), full-year guide raised. 29% below its high at about 22x next year's profit.

cards.name: Alphabet
cards.trigger: The $288 limit filled. WAIT on a second slice until the 2027 capex figure (early Feb) and search growth of at least 12%.
cards.story: Cloud sales doubled (+103%) and search still grew 12%. The Oct 29 profit miss was partly an $8.7B one-off investment loss.

cards.name: Infineon · Xetra
cards.trigger: WAIT. No order. Fri close EUR 45.44, below EUR 46, so the Nov 27 review is off. Reconsider after 3 closes above EUR 48.50 and no new US chip rule.
cards.story: Guides next year +22% on data-center power chips, but the cash flow guide is below hopes. The drop is chip-sector mood.

cards.name: Microsoft
cards.trigger: WAIT. No order now. After the Fed decision (Wed Dec 9): BUY 1 with a limit at $460, only if VIX is below 25 and MSFT has not closed below $440.
cards.story: Revenue grows about 19% with Azure +48%. But bookings fell and capex is about $170B a year, so buy only lower.

cards.name: Schneider Electric · Paris
cards.trigger: WAIT. Cancel the EUR 235 limit if placed: SU trades about EUR 228. No new order before full-year results (late Feb 2027); then BUY 2 at EUR 224 if a cash flow guide is given.
cards.story: Organic growth +16.9%, record backlog, guidance raised. Fell on the PTC deal and a Middle East warning, not slower demand.

cards.name: TSMC
cards.trigger: WAIT. BUY 1 only after a close above $385, with a limit at that close or $395, whichever is lower.
cards.story: October sales +59.7%, Jan-Oct +43.3%. The drop is chip-sector mood, not TSMC news.

cards.name: Software AI fear: Salesforce, SAP
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy before Salesforce results Wed Dec 2. From Fri Dec 4: reconsider 2 CRM at or below that close if organic growth holds and no guide is cut.
cards.story: Without acquisitions Salesforce grows only about 6-7%. Cheap at about 15x next year's profit, but not yet a buy.

cards.name: Broadcom
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy before results (Wed Dec 9). Reconsider Fri Dec 11 only if the AI chip guide is kept and Google orders are not confirmed lower.
cards.story: Revenue +86% and AI chips +221%, but a report of a Google order cut hit it -12%. Non-AI chips grow only low single digits.

cards.name: Caterpillar
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy in this selloff. Reconsider after Q4 results and the 2027 guide (Wed Jan 28, 2027) only if sales growth stays mid-teens.
cards.story: Q3 sales +17%, record backlog, Power Generation +30%. But tariffs cost about $2.2B and the price now moves with AI sentiment.

cards.name: Credo
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy before results (Tue Dec 1, after close). Reconsider Thu Dec 3 only if revenue beats $535M and the optical target is raised.
cards.story: Revenue +115% but slowing to about +97%, and four customers make most of sales. A binary report in a stressed market.

cards.name: European chips: STMicro, ASML
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy. STMicro: reconsider after Q4 results (late Jan 2027) if it closes back above EUR 39. ASML, ASMI: after Q4 results. Infineon: see its card.
cards.story: STMicro sales are fine (+17.9%), but EPS missed and capex is up about 60%. Momentum risk dominates.

cards.name: Intuitive Surgical
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy while the selloff runs. BUY 1 only after 2 closes in a row above $440, with a limit at or below that close.
cards.story: Revenue +22% and procedures +15%, but price cuts lower revenue per procedure. About 34x next year's profit, not cheap.

cards.name: CrowdStrike buys Zscaler
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy. Reconsider only after the deal filing (S-4) shows Zscaler's numbers and CRWD holds above $210 for a week.
cards.story: Fell about 9-10% on an all-stock deal for Zscaler, a slower grower. The quarter is fine but the Q4 guide slows; JPMorgan sees dilution.

agenda.event: Medtronic, Analog Devices; Dell, HP, Workday (after close)
US PCE inflation and Q3 GDP 17:30 Dubai; Deere
